libs.note: BH-9879: the builder's own board close-out. When bin/board-closeout.sh does not post a PR_CREATED/PR_MERGED close-out, bin/lib/rb/result.sh appends bd_refusal_note (` | CLOSEOUT-NOT-POSTED: rc=<n> <why>`) to RESULT line 1, so the reason reaches the job meta and the `result` artifact after the pool machine is reaped. Applied in the close-out block through lib_env_apply builder-direct.

knobs.note: The longest <why> bd_refusal_note puts on the RESULT line, so the line stays well inside the 1024-char artifact_ref column. Code default 160, read as ${BUILDER_DIRECT_REASON_MAX:-160}; a non-integer falls back to 160.
